name: Carmen Valentine
source: Carmen, from house Valentine, grew up and trained in Amarinth with Anastasia. Close childhood friends, Carmen was always protective of Anastasia. When Anastasia took the throne, she appointed Carmen as the head of her military. Carmen is leading a merciless and viciously powerful regime with Anastasia to reclaim lost land for their kingdom and conquer more.
